nodes.label: Functional Spec: WorkflowHub Complexity Governance and Reliable Delivery
Five-Stage Minimal Completion Predicates
nodes.rationale: These are the irreducible formal completion conditions; missing items may still be repaired but the stage stays incomplete, and required independent review being unavailable allows continued repair yet never formal completion - human confirmation is not irreversible authorization.

nodes.label: Unified Current Material Revision
nodes.rationale: Four current materials plus the current code tree and one material revision are the basis for continued work; the requirements ledger and coverage bind to the same revision and lose their independent current pointers, so historical results can never act as a work permit while history stays read-only.

nodes.label: Derived Formal Publication from Current Facts
nodes.rationale: Continuing to work, having a structurally valid result and being good enough to complete are three independent judgements. File existence, a successful command, a provider exit or an old accepted record can never alone constitute completion, and any identity/hash/task/stage/tree/capability mismatch fails immediately rather than partially writing.

nodes.label: Evidence-Driven Vertical Deletion
nodes.rationale: Deletion is premised on equivalent quality semantics, not on falling file or line counts; the zeroing list (dedicated recovery/reopen/rebind/continuation commands, stage-transition authority state, accepted checkpoint edit permits, stage recovery run/source, Grill replacement, phase trace lineage, duplicate fact projections and dual writers) must all reach 0, and no slice may commit without close authorization.

nodes.label: Legacy Task Import Proof and Immediate Exit
nodes.rationale: Only a task-local offline importer is allowed; after frozen fixtures prove no content loss and idempotent repeat import, the reader/importer/schema/fixture are deleted inside the same task so legacy compatibility in final source, release package and public entry points is exactly 0. Dual-writing old and new formats is forbidden and any failed migration proof is a STOP.

nodes.label: Skill Bundle and Runner Release Distribution
nodes.rationale: Skill Bundle is Multica's lightweight consumable and must exclude tests, dependency install directories, historical material, task evidence and host absolute paths; Runner Release independently declares its compatible interface so that a missing or incompatible Runner permits explanation and drafting but forbids formal records or claiming verify/close success.

nodes.label: Runner Contract Version Fields and Match Rule
nodes.rationale: Bundle declares runner_contract_major (positive integer) and runner_contract_min_minor (nonnegative integer); Runner declares runner_contract_major and runner_contract_minor; major must be equal and the Runner minor must be at least the Bundle minimum, with missing fields, wrong types or mismatches all failing loud.

nodes.label: Acceptance Criteria AC-01..AC-15
nodes.rationale: Each AC names its requirements, verification method, pass condition, failure condition and evidence type, so acceptance is machine-checkable; AC-06 and AC-07 bind deletion proof, AC-08 binds legacy zeroing, AC-10/AC-11 bind distribution compatibility and AC-12/AC-14 bind anti-fragile test and non-blocking complexity reporting.

nodes.label: Multica Clean Install Scenario SCN-008
nodes.rationale: Given only a Skill Bundle and a declared-compatible Runner Release, installing into a clean target must resolve the Stage, Skill and review dependency closure completely; the Bundle contains no tests, dependency install directories, historical tasks or host absolute paths, and a missing compatible Runner forbids writing formal results.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking Complexity Budget FR-MET-001
nodes.rationale: Build and verify produce one recomputable static complexity report without adding a runtime metrics system: test lines 12k warning, focused tests 15s cap, full tests 120s cap, public Runner behaviors cap 8, schemas cap 10, persistent object families cap 5, single core file cap 1000 lines, production code cap 15k lines. Overshoot is reported with actual/target/delta and hot spots and never alone fails the delivery, while recovery-state zero, dual-write zero and Bundle-forbidden-content zero stay hard gates.
